Container.Name: photogallery
Container.Overview: [b]PhotoGallery[/b] - Self-hosted photo galleries: public / unlisted / password-protected galleries, share links with expiry and download limits, slideshow, lossless PNG/WebP/TIFF size exports, RAW download, ZIP download, watermarks and moderated guest uploads. Your photo library is mounted read-only; nothing in it is ever modified.
Container.Requires: An Unraid share of photos to publish. Put the container behind a reverse proxy (SWAG, Nginx Proxy Manager, Cloudflare Tunnel) before exposing it to the internet; do not forward the port directly.

Config.Name: WebUI Port
Config.Description: Port for the web interface. With a reverse proxy on a custom Docker network the proxy reaches the container by name and this mapping is only for LAN access.

Config.Name: Photo library (read-only)
Config.Description: Root folder that contains your photo folders. Each gallery points at a sub-folder.

Config.Name: App data
Config.Description: Database, cache of generated sizes, guest uploads, encryption keys

Config.Name: ADMIN_USERNAME
Config.Description: Admin user name asked for at sign-in. Leave empty to sign in with the password only.

Config.Name: OIDC_AUTHORITY
Config.Description: Single sign-on: issuer URL of Keycloak (or another OpenID Connect provider), for example https://auth.example.com/realms/gallery. Leave empty to keep sign-in off.

Config.Name: OIDC_CLIENT_ID
Config.Description: Single sign-on client id

Config.Name: CAPTION_URL
Config.Description: Optional: Ollama server with a vision model for automatic captions, e.g. http://192.168.2.5:11434. Empty turns automatic captions off

Config.Name: CAPTION_MODEL
Config.Description: Vision model name used by CAPTION_URL

Config.Name: OIDC_CLIENT_SECRET
Config.Description: Single sign-on client secret

Config.Name: OIDC_ADMIN_ROLE
Config.Description: Role or group in the provider whose members are admins (their email must be verified)

Config.Name: ADMIN_PASSWORD_LOGIN
Config.Description: Password sign-in for the admin is turned off automatically once single sign-on is configured. Set to true to keep it, or false to turn it off without SSO

Config.Name: ADMIN_PASSWORD
Config.Description: Password for /#/admin. If empty, a random one is generated and printed in the container log on each start.

Config.Name: SITE_TITLE
Config.Description: Initial site name. After first start, change it in the app under Admin, Site settings.

Config.Name: BACKUP_HOURS
Config.Description: Hours between automatic database backups, kept in the data folder under backup (0 = off). Statistics shows them and has a Back up now button.

Config.Name: RESCAN_MINUTES
Config.Description: How often gallery folders are rescanned for new files (0 = off). The Rescan button always works.

Config.Name: SIZES
Config.Description: Long-edge pixel sizes offered as lossless downloads

Config.Name: MAX_UPLOAD_MB
Config.Description: Largest single guest upload (keep under 100: Cloudflare proxy limit)

Config.Name: MAX_PENDING_PER_GALLERY
Config.Description: Cap on unapproved guest uploads per gallery

Config.Name: TRUSTED_PROXIES
Config.Description: Networks allowed to send X-Forwarded-For / CF-Connecting-IP (SWAG on the proxy network). Headers from any other address are ignored, so LAN devices cannot fake an IP.

Config.Name: TRUST_PROXY
Config.Description: Trust X-Forwarded-* headers from SWAG (needed for HTTPS cookies and per-IP rate limits). Do NOT publish the container's port directly to the internet.
